settlementLabel: Crediting this payment in the open makes public the keys of the people it passed through, every amount, and the account that is paid.
reclaimLabel: Taking this payment back makes public the whole chain it passed through, your key and the amounts, even if it could have been credited privately.
gatewayLabel: Lateo's server sees this chain, your network address and the time. The private way, when available, doesn't show it the keys.
selfPayLabel: Your wallet address is stored in the records it pays for, until they are closed.
payeeObligation: Get this payment credited before {{date}} (UTC). After that the person who paid you may take it back, and their security deposit won't cover your loss.
reclaimWindow: You can take an uncredited payment back for {{duration}} after its crediting window, or until its reserve ends if that is sooner. A payment from a key with no registered phone can't be taken back at all.

claim.late: This loss was reported too late: nothing was destroyed. You weren't repaid: the security deposit isn't paid out.
claim.already: The payer spent this money twice and their security deposit was already destroyed. You weren't repaid: the deposit isn't paid out.
claim.reported: The payer spent this money twice. Their security deposit is destroyed. You weren't repaid: the deposit isn't paid out.
claim.noBond: The payer's reserve has nothing left to destroy. You weren't repaid: the security deposit isn't paid out.
claim.lockEnded: The payer's reserve has ended, so the loss can't be reported any more. You weren't repaid.
claim.cannotFile: This loss can't be reported against the payer's reserve. You weren't repaid.
claim.unavailable: Lateo could not file the loss now. Keep this payment and try again later.

refusal.conflict: The payer spent this money twice and another payment of it was credited first. You weren't repaid, so keep this payment.
refusal.noTokenAccount: The account that is paid can't receive this money yet. Set it up in the wallet, then try again.
refusal.window: The time to credit this payment has run out.
refusal.closed: The time to take this payment back has run out.
refusal.deadline: The approval to take this payment back is out of date. Approve it again.
refusal.horizonUnknown: Lateo can't cover the network fee yet. Try again later, or pay it yourself.
refusal.horizon: Lateo can't cover the network fee before {{date}} (UTC). You can pay it yourself now.
refusal.belowMinimum: This amount is too small for Lateo to cover the network fee. You can pay it yourself.
refusal.default: Lateo can't cover the network fee now. You can pay it yourself.

balance: The balance adds up every account of this wallet that holds this money.
